claims.statement: A 2026 multisite evaluation found health systems already integrate automated waitlists into scheduling and fill a median 38.8% of offered appointments; a founder can seek a clinic service contract granting real-time access to released slots and the exclusive right to message an opt-in waitlist, though Polish system APIs and privacy roles are unverified.

An appointment cancelled late or missed is perishable inventory: NHS England reported 16 million missed GP appointments in 2025, while automated-waitlist appointments in the multisite study had a 3.1% missed rate versus 6.6% overall, supporting both the loss and a measurable fill intervention, albeit outside Poland.

The payer is a private clinic owner or operations manager from recovered visit revenue, triggered when a slot opens inside 72 hours; a current Warsaw clinic price list shows common specialist consultations at PLN 230-250, giving a visible revenue pool against which a per-filled-slot fee can be paid.

contrary_evidence: The strongest fill-rate evidence is from US health systems and the loss statistic is from England, not Polish private clinics.
Large clinic groups and scheduling vendors can add waitlist automation directly, and patients may already use broad physician marketplaces.

economics.acquisition_route: Recruit five independent Warsaw specialist clinics through the founder's medical-adjacent network, sign a data-processing and recovered-revenue agreement, and connect first by calendar export before funding custom integrations.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Prove 300 incremental visits, then reach 500 clinics filling 40 slots monthly at PLN 35 net revenue per fill for PLN 8.4m annual revenue; if clinic acquisition and messaging costs allow a 25-35% operating margin, retained founder equity and cash could exceed PLN 5m in 5-7 years.
economics.founder_time: Founder spends 2-3 hours daily on prediction, matching and integration; clinic staff retain clinical triage and a contracted support operator handles patient exceptions.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Automated messaging and matching have low marginal cost, but integration and support are material; preliminary gross-margin target is 60-75% after message fees and clinic support.
economics.payback: The clinic pays only from attended recovered visits, so unit payback is immediate; integration cost should recover after roughly 30-60 additional attended consultations per clinic.
economics.pricing: PLN 25-50 per attended slot recovered or 12-20% of collected visit revenue, with no charge for an unfilled or no-show replacement.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every cancellation and no-show replenishes inventory; waitlist response and attendance history improve matching, while clinic calendar integrations make monthly use habitual.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Cross-clinic data on response latency, specialty, distance and attendance predicts which patient will actually accept and show, increasing recovered revenue per alert.
fingerprint.customer: Independent Polish private specialist clinics with meaningful self-pay calendars and recurrent late cancellations.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Clinic-management accountants, medical practice software consultants and physician referrals, starting with a Warsaw medical network.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Real-time cancellation inventory matching to opt-in patients, priced only on attended recovered appointments.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The clinic owner pays a recovery fee when a previously empty appointment is filled and the patient attends and pays.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A cancellation, reschedule or predicted high-risk no-show inside the clinic's chosen release window.

founder_fit: Prediction, scheduling and measurable incremental revenue align with the founder's data-science and automation strengths.
The founder's girlfriend's medical training may provide grounded workflow discovery and warm introductions without making her a required operator.
Outcome pricing and calendar-led automation allow a low-capital part-time pilot without founder camera exposure.
risks: Patient messaging and scheduling data can expose health information, requiring precise GDPR roles, minimisation and security.
Overbooking or poor matching can harm care continuity and clinic reputation.
Incrementality is difficult to prove if clinic staff or existing software would have filled the slot anyway.

structure.control_point: Clinic-granted real-time right to release cancelled slots to an opt-in waitlist
structure.critical_dependency: Reliable calendar access and consented patient messaging with provable incremental attendance

thesis: Acquire the right to market each clinic's expiring appointment inventory, predict the patients most likely to accept and attend on short notice, and charge only when a slot that would have expired empty becomes collected visit revenue.
title: Private Clinic Slot Salvage Exchange
uncertainties: Polish private-clinic no-show and late-cancellation rates are not yet measured.
Availability and cost of integrations with the dominant Polish clinic systems are unknown.
Patients' willingness to join cross-clinic or clinic-specific rapid waitlists is untested.
